description: Sign the user in to their personal Outlook mailbox. Call it when any other tool answers "Not signed in" or that the sign-in has expired. It opens a Microsoft sign-in page in the user's browser and waits for them to finish. If the result is "pending", ask the user to complete the sign-in in their browser, then call mail_login again. It asks for access to read and organize mail only: it never asks for permission to send email. Safe to call when already signed in.
name: mail_login
title: Sign in to Outlook
